column1: # Extra shortcuts applied only by `setup.sh tiling` (Krohnkite).
# Same format as shortcuts.tsv. These take over the arrow-key window bindings that
# KDE uses for quick-tiling, switching windows and moving them between screens.
## Tiling (Krohnkite)
kwin | KrohnkiteFocusLeft | Meta+Left | Focus window left
kwin | KrohnkiteFocusRight | Meta+Right | Focus window right
kwin | KrohnkiteFocusUp | Meta+Up | Focus window up
kwin | KrohnkiteFocusDown | Meta+Down | Focus window down
kwin | KrohnkiteShiftLeft | Meta+Alt+Left | Move window left
kwin | KrohnkiteShiftRight | Meta+Alt+Right | Move window right
kwin | KrohnkiteShiftUp | Meta+Alt+Up | Move window up
kwin | KrohnkiteShiftDown | Meta+Alt+Down | Move window down
kwin | KrohnkiteShrinkWidth | Meta+Shift+Left | Shrink window width
kwin | KrohnkitegrowWidth | Meta+Shift+Right | Grow window width
kwin | KrohnkiteShrinkHeight | Meta+Shift+Up | Shrink window height
kwin | KrohnkiteGrowHeight | Meta+Shift+Down | Grow window height
kwin | KrohnkiteToggleFloat | Meta+V | Toggle floating window
kwin | KrohnkiteFloatAll | Meta+Shift+V | Toggle floating for all windows (back to tiling)
kwin | KrohnkiteNextLayout | Meta+\ | Next layout (tree / monocle / floating / spiral)
kwin | KrohnkiteRotate | Meta+R | Rotate layout
kwin | KrohnkiteIncrease | none | -
kwin | KrohnkiteDecrease | none | -
kwin | KrohnkiteTileLayout | none | -
kwin | KrohnkiteMonocleLayout | none | -
## Stock KDE bindings the tiling keys replace
kwin | Edit Tiles | none | -
kwin | Window Quick Tile Bottom | none | -
kwin | Window Quick Tile Left | none | -
kwin | Window Quick Tile Right | none | -
kwin | Window Quick Tile Top | none | -
kwin | Switch Window Down | none | -
kwin | Switch Window Left | none | -
kwin | Switch Window Right | none | -
kwin | Switch Window Up | none | -
kwin | Window to Next Screen | none | -
kwin | Window to Previous Screen | none | -
kwin | Window On All Desktops | Meta+T | Pin window (visible on every desktop)
